mappings.coverage: whole lookup within valid projected arrays and pure name accessors
mappings.qualification: Projected valid global type and registry bucket arrays; name bytes encode Latin1 with C NUL termination. Native type==count executes indexed lookup. Tests allocate the extra readable slot; an absent slot is an unsafe original read, not an invented null result. Negative counts and record counts preserved. Invalid pointers, concurrent registry mutation and arbitrary callback side effects excluded.
mappings.comparisonStatus: Original native verified; portable compile and execution tracked independently.
